question: US x Cuba military clash in 2026?

rule_facts.window: Frozen description: from market creation through 2026-12-31 23:59 ET. Gamma createdAt (not startDate) is the observed market-creation field.
rule_facts.qualifying_force: Direct engagement/use of force between US and Cuban military forces; examples include strikes/fire/exchange of gunfire. US Coast Guard counts as US military; Cuban Border Guard counts as Cuban military. Intentional military-ship ramming qualifies only with significant damage/sinking; minor scrapes/dents excluded. Warning shots, fire into uninhabited areas, and missiles landing in territorial waters/passing through airspace excluded. Resolution source: consensus of credible reporting.

facts.reported: Al Jazeera says Cuban Interior Ministry reported an exchange of gunfire after Cuban Border Guard personnel approached a Florida-registered speedboat; four occupants killed, six injured, Cuban vessel commander injured. Ministry characterized occupants as Cuban residents of the US and alleged an armed infiltration. Al Jazeera reports Rubio said US Coast Guard had been deployed to the area and US officials were seeking independent verification.
facts.window_actor_note: Cuban Border Guard is an explicitly included force. Source describes the opposing vessel as a speedboat with civilian occupants; US registration/residence/citizenship does not make occupants US military. The report places the shooting in the morning; Gamma creation was 21:56Z (16:56 EST) that day, so reported incident predates start. No source here reports US Coast Guard firing or engaging Cuban forces.

facts.reported: AP search-result excerpt says Cuban authorities reported men captured in February after attempting to enter Cuba by force from the US; this is retrospective prosecution/investigation reporting about the same February episode, not a newly reported October military encounter. The excerpt describes US-Cuba tensions, energy restrictions and US officials not ruling out military action as political posture.
facts.window_actor_note: No new direct use of force between US and Cuban military forces is alleged in the accessible excerpt. This bounded search does not establish absence of other incidents.
